table.name: TLGNS_SAP_VEHICLE
table.description: Vehicle data, received from SAP in Vehicle Notification Interface.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_ID
column.description: PK. Technical key, given by Logon.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NO
column.description: Equipment Number/identifier, leading zeros are trimmed. SAP: vehicle_master_data / EQUNR (trimmed).

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IFC_NO
column.description: Equipment Number/identifier, exactly as received and also used for sending to other systems, i.e. including the leading zeros. SAP: vehicle_master_data / EQUNR (original).

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_NAME
column.description: Identification number for fleet object. SAP: vehicle_master_data / FLEET_NUM

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_vendor. Carrier who owns the vehicle. Subcontracting Carrier. SAP: if vehicle_master_adata/vehicle_partner_functions/PARVW==ZC Then vehicle_master_adata/vehicle_partner_functions/I_PARNR ELSE else fail to import. Vehicle has to be linked to a subcontractor.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_vehicle_type. SAP: /vehicle_master_Data/vehicle_classification/ATWRT for repetition of vehicle_classification where CLASS == VEHICLE_TYPE.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_MAX_GROSS_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Max allowed gross weight of the vehicle in unit of measure tons. SAP: /vehicle/_master_data/GROSS_WGT.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TRAILER_EQP_NO
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_vehicle. SAP Equipment number of attached trailer. SAP: /vehicle_master_data/vehicle_trailer/EQNACH.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_TRUCK_EQP_NO
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_vehicle. SAP Equipment number of the truck the trailer is attached to. SAP: /vehicle_master_data/vehicle_trailer/EQVON.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG
column.description: Internal means owned by Crh company, only relevant for costs calculation in SAP ‘V’ (internal) is stored as 1 Else its stored as 0 SAP: /vehicle_master_data/EQTYP

column.name: COMPANYCODE_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_companycode_bs. Company code the vehicle belongs to. MUST be set if SAP_VEHICLE_IS_INTERNAL_FLAG is set.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_PROCESSED_FLAG
column.description: Postprocessing flag. True when the row has already been postprocessed by the vehicle notification postprocessing service.

column.name: SAP_VEHICLE_IS_IMPORTED_FLAG
column.description: Postprocessing flag. True when The row has already been imported succesfully.
